prints.name: Cable Routing Clips
prints.description: Under-desk cable management clips that snap onto desk rails. Printed a batch of 20 — finally tamed the cable chaos behind the monitor.

prints.name: Phone Cradle
prints.description: Minimal desk phone stand with two fixed viewing angles. Has a MagSafe-compatible slot cut into the base so the charger cable routes through cleanly.

prints.name: Headphone Hook
prints.description: Under-desk headphone hanger. One piece, no hardware — just two screws into the underside of the desk. Holds the cans out of the way without looking cluttered.

prints.name: Geometric Planter
prints.description: Low-poly succulent pot with drainage hole and removable saucer. Currently housing a fat little haworthia. The faceted geometry actually hides layer lines really well.

prints.name: Ruined Stone Wall
prints.description: 28mm scale dungeon terrain for TTRPG sessions. One modular piece of a larger ruin set I'm slowly building out. Primed grey, still needs painting.

prints.name: SD Card Wallet
prints.description: Snap-lid hard case for 12 full-size and 8 micro SD cards. Fits in a jacket pocket. Still dialing in the snap-fit tolerances.
